_comment: Per-agent model overrides. Copy to ~/.glados/model-overrides.json (outside the repo, gitignored). Maps an agent id to a bare Anthropic Messages model alias such as claude-sonnet-5 or claude-opus-4-8. These WIN over the registry/agent.json defaults, survive updates, and are used by the v4 Agent SDK harness. Remove the _comment and _examples keys in your real file.
